title: Ry August's "Something Real": A Testament to Perseverance and Artistry in Pop Music
htmlContent:
Ry August's "Something Real" is more than just another pop song. It's a testament to perseverance and the power of self-discovery. After a disappointing release, Ry found the strength to keep creating and pushed himself to unlock a new level of his artistry. The result is a track that effortlessly blends pop and rap elements, showcasing Ry's versatility and range.

Collaborating with his friend Alex Delzer on production, Ry creates a dynamic and catchy beat that perfectly complements his smooth vocals. The lyrics are introspective and relatable, touching on the universal themes of love, self-doubt, and the desire for authenticity.

The accompanying music video, shot in LA with June Jissle, adds another layer of depth to the song. Stunning visuals and a captivating storyline bring Ry's vision to life and immerses the viewer in his world.

As an independent artist, Ry's journey hasn't been easy, but his passion and dedication to his craft shine through in every note of "Something Real." This track is not just a triumph for Ry but a testament to the power of hard work, perseverance, and self-belief.
